problems: Both repaired dossiers validate with 0 errors and 0 warnings (--resolve), written to the mount at 11:46 on 2026-10-25 and read back intact; the group notes file was updated (islamic-state and autonomous-administration sections).

Keyframe convention made explicit in both dossiers: the shape as of 31 December of its first year (islamic-state now has six keyframes: 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017 Hajin pocket, 2018-2019 Baghuz pocket; the old 2018 and 2019 keyframes were replaced); the two dossiers' keyframes were checked cell by cell and do not overlap in 2013-2018 (2019 shares only the Baghuz cell). Syrian and Iraqi border discs are now intersected with the country.

Disagreements with the reviewer, recorded in the notes: Sinjar stays in the 2014 shape (cut from the June gain instead, so the August gain is real); Ramadi follows the reviewer's second option (note, not subtraction).

Mirrors still needed in other groups' files: syria (ledger/11 gives the whole Hasakah governorate to the AANES in 2012; no 2016-2017 Palmyra, Raqqa, Deir ez-Zor or Hasakah events from the IS side), republic-of-iraq (May 2015 loss of Ramadi), republic-of-turkey (ledger/7 dates the whole Euphrates Shield area to 2016-08 and names syria, while al-Bab fell on 23 February 2017; the IS losses of Jarabulus and al-Bab name republic-of-turkey, an accepted exception like the AANES Afrin and Tell Abyad losses).
The counterpart string 'Syrian opposition' was used instead of the slug-like 'syrian-opposition' to avoid validator warnings; the syria dossier uses the slug form.
al-Hawl coordinates (41.03 E, 36.38 N) are approximate: no page opened gives them.
